as_told.title: Pat Price's death and disappearance in an unmarked ambulance

plain: A former US Army sergeant, Lyn Buchanan, talks about the death of a man named Pat Price in 1975, in a story that also involves a man named Hal Puthoff. Buchanan says he has heard from people who were there a different account from the published one, and in one telling he adds that it happened in Washington DC, that an unmarked ambulance was involved, and that a head of security later said that Price died "and we haven't heard from him since." The remark suggests, as Buchanan tells it, that Price's death may not have been what it seemed.
